```{r sql_aggregation, include=FALSE, cache=FALSE, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
if (!exists("params_cfg")) {
  cfg_path <- here::here("config.yaml")
  params_cfg <- if (file.exists(cfg_path)) yaml::read_yaml(cfg_path) else list()
}

is_flag_enabled <- function(val, default = TRUE) {
  if (is.null(val)) return(default)
  if (is.logical(val)) return(isTRUE(val))
  val_str <- tolower(trimws(as.character(val)))
  if (val_str %in% c("false", "no", "0", "off", "disabled")) return(FALSE)
  if (val_str %in% c("true", "yes", "1", "on", "enabled")) return(TRUE)
  default
}

sla_file_path <- params_cfg$sla_file_path
has_sla_file  <- !is.null(sla_file_path) && nzchar(trimws(sla_file_path)) && file.exists(here::here(sla_file_path))
sla_config    <- if (!is.null(params_cfg$sla_rules) || !is.null(params_cfg$response_time_sla)) {
  params_cfg
} else if (has_sla_file) {
  yaml::read_yaml(here::here(sla_file_path))
} else NULL
sla_rules     <- if (!is.null(sla_config)) sla_config$sla_rules else NULL
rt_sla_config <- if (!is.null(sla_config)) sla_config$response_time_sla else NULL

show_overall_status <- is_flag_enabled(
  if (!is.null(params_cfg$show_overall_status)) params_cfg$show_overall_status
  else if (!is.null(sla_config) && !is.null(sla_config$show_overall_status)) sla_config$show_overall_status
  else TRUE,
  default = TRUE
)

rt_sla_enabled <- is_flag_enabled(
  if (!is.null(rt_sla_config) && !is.null(rt_sla_config$enabled)) rt_sla_config$enabled else TRUE,
  default = TRUE
)

is_metric_sla_enabled <- function(metric_name) {
  if (is.null(sla_rules)) return(FALSE)
  matched <- Filter(function(x) identical(x$metric, metric_name), sla_rules)
  if (length(matched) == 0) return(FALSE)
  is_flag_enabled(matched[[1]]$enabled, default = TRUE)
}

vu_sla_enabled  <- is_metric_sla_enabled("total_users")
er_sla_enabled  <- is_metric_sla_enabled("error_rate")
tps_sla_enabled <- is_metric_sla_enabled("throughput")

rt_metric        <- if (!is.null(rt_sla_config) && !is.null(rt_sla_config$metric)) tolower(rt_sla_config$metric) else "p95"
rt_percentile    <- switch(rt_metric, "p90" = 0.90, "p95" = 0.95, "p99" = 0.99, 0.95)
rt_default       <- if (!is.null(rt_sla_config) && !is.null(rt_sla_config$default_threshold)) as.numeric(rt_sla_config$default_threshold) else 500
rt_tolerance_pct <- if (!is.null(rt_sla_config) && !is.null(rt_sla_config$tolerance_pct)) as.numeric(rt_sla_config$tolerance_pct) else 0

con <- dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb(shared_home = FALSE), dbdir = params$db_path, read_only = TRUE)

target_table <- paste0("performance_history_", params$tool)
if (!target_table %in% dbListTables(con)) {
  dbDisconnect(con)
  stop(paste0("Error: Table '", target_table, "' does not exist in vault."))
}

all_identifiers <- dbGetQuery(con, sprintf(
  "SELECT DISTINCT run_id, sequence_num FROM %s", target_table
))

resolved_run_ids <- sapply(unlist(params$runs), function(r) {
  match_by_run_id <- all_identifiers$run_id[all_identifiers$run_id == r]
  if (length(match_by_run_id) > 0) return(match_by_run_id[1])

  match_by_seq <- all_identifiers$run_id[as.character(all_identifiers$sequence_num) == as.character(r)]
  if (length(match_by_seq) > 0) return(match_by_seq[1])

  return(NA_character_)
})

missing_runs <- unlist(params$runs)[is.na(resolved_run_ids)]
if (length(missing_runs) > 0) {
  dbDisconnect(con)
  stop(paste0("Error: Run(s) not found in vault: ", paste(missing_runs, collapse = ", ")))
}

resolved_run_ids  <- unique(unname(resolved_run_ids))
formatted_run_ids <- paste0("'", gsub("'", "''", resolved_run_ids), "'", collapse = ", ")

sql_filter_clause <- ""
if (!is.null(params$label_filter) &&
    nzchar(trimws(params$label_filter)) &&
    toupper(trimws(params$label_filter)) != "NONE") {
  raw_tokens     <- unlist(strsplit(params$label_filter, ","))
  cleaned_tokens <- trimws(raw_tokens)
  cleaned_tokens <- cleaned_tokens[nzchar(cleaned_tokens)]
  if (length(cleaned_tokens) > 0) {
    escaped_tokens    <- gsub("'", "''", cleaned_tokens)
    token_clauses     <- sprintf("label LIKE '%%%s%%'", escaped_tokens)
    sql_filter_clause <- paste0(" AND (", paste(token_clauses, collapse = " OR "), ")")
  }
}

effective_exclusions <- unlist(params$excluded_labels)
effective_exclusions <- effective_exclusions[nzchar(trimws(effective_exclusions))]
if (!is.null(params$label_filter) && nzchar(trimws(params$label_filter))) {
  requested_labels     <- trimws(unlist(strsplit(params$label_filter, ",")))
  effective_exclusions <- setdiff(effective_exclusions, requested_labels)
}

sql_exclusion_clause <- ""
if (length(effective_exclusions) > 0) {
  escaped_excl         <- paste0("'", gsub("'", "''", effective_exclusions), "'", collapse = ", ")
  sql_exclusion_clause <- paste0(" AND label NOT IN (", escaped_excl, ")")
}

where_clause <- sprintf("WHERE run_id IN (%s)%s%s", formatted_run_ids, sql_filter_clause, sql_exclusion_clause)

is_pass_expr <- "LOWER(TRIM(CAST(success AS VARCHAR))) IN ('true', 'yes', '1')"

response_code_col <- if (params$tool == "jmeter") "REGEXP_REPLACE(CAST(responseCode AS VARCHAR), '\\.0$', '')" else "'N/A'"
response_msg_col  <- if (params$tool == "jmeter") "CAST(responseMessage AS VARCHAR)" else "'Unknown Error'"

total_users_expr <- if (params$tool == "jmeter") {
  "GREATEST(COALESCE(MAX(TRY_CAST(allThreads AS INTEGER)), 0), COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(app_name, '|', thread_group, '|', threadName)))"
} else {
  "COUNT(DISTINCT user_index)"
}

active_users_expr <- if (params$tool == "jmeter") {
  "GREATEST(COALESCE(MAX(TRY_CAST(t.allThreads AS INTEGER)), 0), COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(t.app_name, '|', t.thread_group, '|', t.threadName)))"
} else {
  "COUNT(DISTINCT t.user_index)"
}

sql_run_summary <- sprintf("
  SELECT
    run_id,
    FIRST(sequence_num) AS sequence_num,
    FIRST(project_name) AS project_name,
    FIRST(test_name) AS test_name,
    MIN(timestamp) AS start_time,
    MAX(timestamp) AS end_time,
    GREATEST( date_diff('milliseconds', MIN(timestamp), MAX(timestamp)) / 1000.0, 1.0 ) AS duration_secs,
    %s AS total_users,
    COUNT(*) AS total_tx,
    SUM(CASE WHEN %s THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS passed_tx,
    SUM(CASE WHEN NOT (%s) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed_tx,
    ROUND(QUANTILE_CONT(elapsed, %f), 0) AS pct_rt
  FROM %s
  %s
  GROUP BY run_id
  ORDER BY sequence_num ASC
", total_users_expr, is_pass_expr, is_pass_expr, rt_percentile, target_table, where_clause)

db_run_summary <- dbGetQuery(con, sql_run_summary)

if (nrow(db_run_summary) == 0) {
  dbDisconnect(con)
  stop(paste0(
    "Error: No transactions matched query criteria.\n",
    "  Runs: ", paste(resolved_run_ids, collapse = ", "), "\n",
    "  Filter: '", params$label_filter, "'"
  ))
}

db_run_summary <- db_run_summary %>%
  mutate(
    duration_mins = round(duration_secs / 60, 0),
    throughput    = round(passed_tx / duration_secs, 2),
    error_rate    = round((failed_tx / total_tx) * 100, 2)
  )

sql_app_summary <- sprintf("
  SELECT
    run_id,
    app_name,
    COUNT(*) AS transactions,
    SUM(CASE WHEN %s THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successful_transactions,
    SUM(CASE WHEN NOT (%s) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS errors,
    GREATEST( date_diff('milliseconds', MIN(timestamp), MAX(timestamp)) / 1000.0, 1.0 ) AS duration_secs,
    ROUND(QUANTILE_CONT(elapsed, %f), 0) AS pct_rt
  FROM %s
  %s
  GROUP BY run_id, app_name
  ORDER BY app_name ASC
", is_pass_expr, is_pass_expr, rt_percentile, target_table, where_clause)

db_app_summary <- dbGetQuery(con, sql_app_summary) %>%
  mutate(
    throughput = round(successful_transactions / duration_secs, 2),
    error_rate = round((errors / transactions) * 100, 2)
  )

clean_scenario_expr <- "TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(thread_group, '^([0-9]{1,3}(\\.[0-9]{1,3}){3}[-\\s]*)?(Thread Group\\s*-\\s*)?', '', 'i'))"

sql_scenario_summary <- sprintf("
  SELECT
    run_id,
    app_name,
    %s AS logical_scenario,
    COUNT(*) AS requests,
    SUM(CASE WHEN %s THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successful_transactions,
    SUM(CASE WHEN NOT (%s) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS errors,
    GREATEST( date_diff('milliseconds', MIN(timestamp), MAX(timestamp)) / 1000.0, 1.0 ) AS duration_secs,
    ROUND(QUANTILE_CONT(elapsed, %f), 0) AS pct_rt
  FROM %s
  %s
  GROUP BY run_id, app_name, logical_scenario
  ORDER BY app_name, logical_scenario
", clean_scenario_expr, is_pass_expr, is_pass_expr, rt_percentile, target_table, where_clause)

db_logical_scenario_summary <- dbGetQuery(con, sql_scenario_summary) %>%
  mutate(
    throughput   = round(successful_transactions / duration_secs, 2),
    error_rate   = round((errors / requests) * 100, 2),
    thread_group = logical_scenario
  )

db_scenario_summary <- db_logical_scenario_summary

sql_label_rt <- sprintf("
  SELECT
    run_id,
    label,
    ROUND(QUANTILE_CONT(elapsed, %f), 0) AS actual_rt,
    COUNT(*) AS tx_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN NOT (%s) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS errors
  FROM %s
  %s
  GROUP BY run_id, label
", rt_percentile, is_pass_expr, target_table, where_clause)

db_label_rt <- dbGetQuery(con, sql_label_rt) %>%
  mutate(error_rate = round((errors / tx_count) * 100, 2))

sql_label_scen_map <- sprintf("
  SELECT DISTINCT
    run_id,
    app_name,
    %s AS logical_scenario,
    label
  FROM %s
  %s
", clean_scenario_expr, target_table, where_clause)

db_label_scen_map <- dbGetQuery(con, sql_label_scen_map) %>%
  mutate(thread_group = logical_scenario)

sql_error_summary <- sprintf("
  SELECT
    run_id,
    app_name,
    label,
    COUNT(*) AS total_transactions,
    SUM(CASE WHEN NOT (%s) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS errors
  FROM %s
  %s
  GROUP BY run_id, app_name, label
  HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN NOT (%s) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
  ORDER BY errors DESC
", is_pass_expr, target_table, where_clause, is_pass_expr)

db_error_summary <- dbGetQuery(con, sql_error_summary) %>%
  mutate(
    error_rate = round((errors / total_transactions) * 100, 2)
  )

sql_error_details <- sprintf("
  SELECT
    run_id,
    app_name,
    label,
    %s AS responseCode,
    %s AS responseMessage,
    COUNT(*) AS error_count
  FROM %s
  %s AND NOT (%s)
  GROUP BY run_id, app_name, label, responseCode, responseMessage
  ORDER BY app_name, label, error_count DESC
", response_code_col, response_msg_col, target_table, where_clause, is_pass_expr)

db_error_details <- dbGetQuery(con, sql_error_details)

# 3G. 1-Minute Bucketed Time-Series per Run (for lightweight Executive Charts Modal)
where_clause_t <- sprintf("WHERE t.run_id IN (%s)%s%s", formatted_run_ids, sql_filter_clause, sql_exclusion_clause)
sql_timeseries <- sprintf("
  WITH run_bounds AS (
    SELECT run_id, MIN(timestamp) AS min_ts
    FROM %s
    %s
    GROUP BY run_id
  )
  SELECT
    t.run_id,
    'ALL' AS app_name,
    CAST(FLOOR(date_diff('seconds', b.min_ts, t.timestamp) / 60.0) AS INTEGER) AS elapsed_min,
    COUNT(*) AS total_tx,
    SUM(CASE WHEN %s THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS passed_tx,
    SUM(CASE WHEN NOT (%s) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed_tx,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN %s THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 60.0, 2) AS tps,
    ROUND(QUANTILE_CONT(t.elapsed, %f), 0) AS pct_rt,
    %s AS active_users
  FROM %s t
  JOIN run_bounds b ON t.run_id = b.run_id
  %s
  GROUP BY t.run_id, elapsed_min
  HAVING elapsed_min >= 0
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    t.run_id,
    t.app_name,
    CAST(FLOOR(date_diff('seconds', b.min_ts, t.timestamp) / 60.0) AS INTEGER) AS elapsed_min,
    COUNT(*) AS total_tx,
    SUM(CASE WHEN %s THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS passed_tx,
    SUM(CASE WHEN NOT (%s) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed_tx,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN %s THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 60.0, 2) AS tps,
    ROUND(QUANTILE_CONT(t.elapsed, %f), 0) AS pct_rt,
    %s AS active_users
  FROM %s t
  JOIN run_bounds b ON t.run_id = b.run_id
  %s
  GROUP BY t.run_id, t.app_name, elapsed_min
  HAVING elapsed_min >= 0
  ORDER BY run_id, app_name, elapsed_min ASC
", target_table, where_clause, is_pass_expr, is_pass_expr, is_pass_expr, rt_percentile, active_users_expr, target_table, where_clause_t,
   is_pass_expr, is_pass_expr, is_pass_expr, rt_percentile, active_users_expr, target_table, where_clause_t)

db_timeseries <- dbGetQuery(con, sql_timeseries)

# 3G-2. Telemetry-Based Workload Phase Detection (Ramp-Up, Steady State, Ramp-Down)
sql_workload_phases <- if (params$tool == "jmeter") {
  sprintf("
    WITH run_peaks AS (
      SELECT
        run_id,
        MIN(timestamp) AS min_ts,
        MAX(timestamp) AS max_ts,
        COALESCE(MAX(TRY_CAST(allThreads AS INTEGER)), 0) AS peak_all_threads
      FROM %s
      %s
      GROUP BY run_id
    ),
    thread_births AS (
      SELECT
        run_id,
        CONCAT(app_name, '|', thread_group, '|', threadName) AS tid,
        MIN(timestamp) AS birth_ts
      FROM %s
      %s
      GROUP BY run_id, tid
    ),
    birth_quantiles AS (
      SELECT
        run_id,
        QUANTILE_CONT(birth_ts, 0.98) AS p98_birth_ts
      FROM thread_births
      GROUP BY run_id
    )
    SELECT
      t.run_id,
      p.peak_all_threads,
      CASE
        WHEN p.peak_all_threads > 0 THEN
          COALESCE(date_diff('seconds', p.min_ts, MIN(CASE WHEN TRY_CAST(t.allThreads AS INTEGER) >= p.peak_all_threads THEN t.timestamp END)), 0)
        ELSE
          COALESCE(date_diff('seconds', p.min_ts, bq.p98_birth_ts), 0)
      END AS ramp_up_secs,
      CASE
        WHEN p.peak_all_threads > 0 THEN
          COALESCE(date_diff('seconds', MAX(CASE WHEN TRY_CAST(t.allThreads AS INTEGER) >= FLOOR(p.peak_all_threads * 0.98) THEN t.timestamp END), p.max_ts), 0)
        ELSE CAST(NULL AS BIGINT)
      END AS ramp_down_secs
    FROM %s t
    JOIN run_peaks p ON t.run_id = p.run_id
    LEFT JOIN birth_quantiles bq ON t.run_id = bq.run_id
    %s
    GROUP BY t.run_id, p.min_ts, p.max_ts, p.peak_all_threads, bq.p98_birth_ts
  ", target_table, where_clause, target_table, where_clause, target_table, where_clause_t)
} else {
  sprintf("
    WITH run_peaks AS (
      SELECT run_id, MIN(timestamp) AS min_ts, MAX(timestamp) AS max_ts
      FROM %s
      %s
      GROUP BY run_id
    ),
    user_births AS (
      SELECT run_id, user_index, MIN(timestamp) AS birth_ts
      FROM %s
      %s
      GROUP BY run_id, user_index
    )
    SELECT
      p.run_id,
      0 AS peak_all_threads,
      COALESCE(date_diff('seconds', p.min_ts, QUANTILE_CONT(ub.birth_ts, 0.98)), 0) AS ramp_up_secs,
      CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS ramp_down_secs
    FROM run_peaks p
    LEFT JOIN user_births ub ON p.run_id = ub.run_id
    GROUP BY p.run_id, p.min_ts
  ", target_table, where_clause, target_table, where_clause)
}

db_workload_phases <- dbGetQuery(con, sql_workload_phases)

db_run_summary <- db_run_summary %>%
  left_join(db_workload_phases, by = "run_id") %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    ramp_up_mins = ifelse(!is.na(ramp_up_secs) && ramp_up_secs >= 0, round(as.numeric(ramp_up_secs) / 60, 0), min(10, max(5, round(duration_mins * 0.15)))),
    ramp_down_mins = {
      if (!is.na(ramp_down_secs)) {
        ifelse(as.numeric(ramp_down_secs) >= 60, round(as.numeric(ramp_down_secs) / 60, 0), 0)
      } else {
        ts_r <- db_timeseries %>% filter(run_id == .data$run_id, app_name == "ALL") %>% arrange(elapsed_min)
        if (nrow(ts_r) > 2 && tail(ts_r$total_tx, 1) < 0.25 * median(ts_r$total_tx, na.rm = TRUE)) {
          ts_r <- ts_r[-nrow(ts_r), , drop = FALSE]
        }
        if (nrow(ts_r) > 2 && max(ts_r$active_users, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
          pk_u <- max(ts_r$active_users, na.rm = TRUE)
          steady_idx <- which(ts_r$active_users >= floor(pk_u * 0.90))
          if (length(steady_idx) > 0) max(0, max(ts_r$elapsed_min) - ts_r$elapsed_min[max(steady_idx)]) else 0
        } else 0
      }
    },
    steady_state_mins = pmax(1, duration_mins - ramp_up_mins - ramp_down_mins)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# 3H. Apdex User Experience & Performance Index per Run
rt_overrides <- if (!is.null(rt_sla_config)) rt_sla_config$overrides else NULL
rt_threshold_lookup <- if (!is.null(rt_overrides) && length(rt_overrides) > 0) {
  setNames(
    sapply(rt_overrides, function(x) as.numeric(x$threshold)),
    sapply(rt_overrides, function(x) as.character(x$label))
  )
} else {
  c()
}

build_sql_target_t <- function(lookup, default_val) {
  if (length(lookup) == 0) {
    return(sprintf("%.1f", as.numeric(default_val)))
  }
  prefixes <- names(lookup)
  prefixes <- prefixes[order(nchar(prefixes), decreasing = TRUE)]
  whens <- sapply(prefixes, function(p) {
    val <- as.numeric(lookup[[p]])
    safe_p <- gsub("'", "''", p)
    sprintf("WHEN label LIKE '%s%%' THEN %.1f", safe_p, val)
  })
  sprintf("(CASE %s ELSE %.1f END)", paste(whens, collapse = " "), as.numeric(default_val))
}

sql_target_t_expr <- build_sql_target_t(rt_threshold_lookup, rt_default)

sql_apdex <- sprintf("
  WITH enriched AS (
    SELECT
      run_id,
      app_name,
      elapsed,
      CASE WHEN %s THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_pass,
      %s AS target_t
    FROM %s
    %s
  )
  SELECT
    run_id,
    'ALL' AS app_name,
    COUNT(*) AS total_tx,
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_pass = 1 AND elapsed <= target_t THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS satisfied,
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_pass = 1 AND elapsed > target_t AND elapsed <= (4.0 * target_t) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tolerating,
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_pass = 0 OR elapsed > (4.0 * target_t) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS frustrated,
    ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN is_pass = 1 AND elapsed <= target_t THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
           0.5 * SUM(CASE WHEN is_pass = 1 AND elapsed > target_t AND elapsed <= (4.0 * target_t) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) /
           CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE), 2) AS apdex_score
  FROM enriched
  GROUP BY run_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    run_id,
    app_name,
    COUNT(*) AS total_tx,
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_pass = 1 AND elapsed <= target_t THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS satisfied,
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_pass = 1 AND elapsed > target_t AND elapsed <= (4.0 * target_t) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tolerating,
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_pass = 0 OR elapsed > (4.0 * target_t) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS frustrated,
    ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN is_pass = 1 AND elapsed <= target_t THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
           0.5 * SUM(CASE WHEN is_pass = 1 AND elapsed > target_t AND elapsed <= (4.0 * target_t) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) /
           CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE), 2) AS apdex_score
  FROM enriched
  GROUP BY run_id, app_name
", is_pass_expr, sql_target_t_expr, target_table, where_clause,
   is_pass_expr, sql_target_t_expr, target_table, where_clause)

db_apdex <- dbGetQuery(con, sql_apdex)
db_latency_bands <- db_apdex

dbDisconnect(con)
```

```{r sla_evaluation, include=FALSE, cache=FALSE, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
sla_results    <- list()
rt_sla_results <- list()

evaluate_sla_rule <- function(actual_value, operator, threshold) {
  switch(
    operator,
    "<=" = actual_value <= threshold,
    ">=" = actual_value >= threshold,
    "<"  = actual_value <  threshold,
    ">"  = actual_value >  threshold,
    "==" = actual_value == threshold,
    NA
  )
}

if (!is.null(sla_rules)) {
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(db_run_summary))) {
    run_row <- db_run_summary[i, ]
    rid     <- run_row$run_id

    rule_outcomes <- lapply(sla_rules, function(rule) {
      rule_enabled <- is_flag_enabled(rule$enabled, default = TRUE)
      actual_value <- switch(
        rule$metric,
        "total_users" = run_row$total_users,
        "error_rate"  = run_row$error_rate,
        "throughput"  = run_row$throughput,
        NA
      )
      passed <- if (!rule_enabled) TRUE else if (!is.na(actual_value)) evaluate_sla_rule(actual_value, rule$operator, rule$threshold) else NA
      list(
        metric    = rule$metric,
        enabled   = rule_enabled,
        label     = rule$label,
        operator  = rule$operator,
        threshold = rule$threshold,
        unit      = if (is.null(rule$unit)) "" else rule$unit,
        actual    = actual_value,
        passed    = passed
      )
    })

    sla_results[[as.character(rid)]] <- list(
      run_id       = rid,
      rules        = rule_outcomes,
      overall_pass = all(sapply(rule_outcomes, function(x) isTRUE(x$passed)))
    )
  }
}

if (!is.null(rt_sla_config)) {
  rt_overrides <- rt_sla_config$overrides
  rt_threshold_lookup <- if (!is.null(rt_overrides) && length(rt_overrides) > 0) {
    setNames(
      sapply(rt_overrides, function(x) x$threshold),
      sapply(rt_overrides, function(x) x$label)
    )
  } else {
    c()
  }

  get_rt_threshold <- function(lbl) {
    matching_prefixes <- names(rt_threshold_lookup)[startsWith(lbl, names(rt_threshold_lookup))]
    if (length(matching_prefixes) > 0) {
      matching_prefixes <- matching_prefixes[order(nchar(matching_prefixes), decreasing = TRUE)]
      return(unname(rt_threshold_lookup[matching_prefixes[1]]))
    }
    rt_default
  }

  rt_per_label <- db_label_rt %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      threshold      = get_rt_threshold(label),
      tolerance_band = threshold * (1 + rt_tolerance_pct / 100),
      passed         = if (isTRUE(rt_sla_enabled)) (actual_rt <= tolerance_band) else TRUE,
      breach_pct     = round(((actual_rt - threshold) / threshold) * 100, 1)
    ) %>%
    ungroup()

  for (rid in unique(rt_per_label$run_id)) {
    run_labels    <- rt_per_label %>% filter(run_id == rid)
    total_labels  <- nrow(run_labels)
    failed_labels <- run_labels %>% filter(!passed)
    failed_count  <- nrow(failed_labels)

    top_breaches <- failed_labels %>%
      arrange(desc(breach_pct)) %>%
      slice_head(n = 10) %>%
      select(label, actual_rt, threshold, breach_pct)

    rt_sla_results[[as.character(rid)]] <- list(
      run_id       = rid,
      enabled      = rt_sla_enabled,
      metric       = rt_metric,
      total_labels = total_labels,
      failed_count = failed_count,
      passed_count = total_labels - failed_count,
      top_breaches = top_breaches,
      all_labels   = run_labels
    )
  }
}

get_run_rt_sla <- function(run_id) {
  key <- as.character(run_id)
  if (length(rt_sla_results) == 0 || is.null(rt_sla_results[[key]])) return(NULL)
  rt_sla_results[[key]]
}

get_app_tps_threshold <- function(app_name) {
  if (is.null(sla_rules)) return(0)
  tp_rules <- Filter(function(x) x$metric == "throughput", sla_rules)
  if (length(tp_rules) == 0) return(0)
  throughput_rule <- tp_rules[[1]]
  overrides       <- throughput_rule$application_thresholds
  if (!is.null(overrides)) {
    app_rule <- Filter(function(x) identical(x$app_name, app_name), overrides)
    if (length(app_rule) > 0) return(as.numeric(app_rule[[1]]$threshold))
  }
  as.numeric(throughput_rule$threshold)
}

get_app_error_threshold <- function(app_name) {
  if (is.null(sla_rules)) return(100)
  er_rules <- Filter(function(x) x$metric == "error_rate", sla_rules)
  if (length(er_rules) == 0) return(100)
  error_rule <- er_rules[[1]]
  overrides  <- error_rule$application_thresholds
  if (!is.null(overrides)) {
    app_rule <- Filter(function(x) identical(x$app_name, app_name), overrides)
    if (length(app_rule) > 0) return(as.numeric(app_rule[[1]]$threshold))
  }
  as.numeric(error_rule$threshold)
}

ai_summary_data <- list(
  runs = lapply(seq_len(nrow(db_run_summary)), function(i) {
    r <- db_run_summary[i, ]
    apps_for_run <- db_app_summary %>% filter(run_id == r$run_id) %>% pull(app_name)
    list(
      run_id        = r$run_id,
      sequence_num  = r$sequence_num,
      test_name     = r$test_name,
      app_name      = paste(apps_for_run, collapse = ", "),
      start_time    = format(r$start_time, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
      end_time      = format(r$end_time, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
      duration_mins = r$duration_mins,
      total_users   = r$total_users,
      total_tx      = r$total_tx,
      throughput    = r$throughput,
      passed        = r$passed_tx,
      failed        = r$failed_tx,
      error_rate    = r$error_rate
    )
  })
)
```
